_about: Licences reviewed for the core track (core/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). tools/ci/check_licences.py fails CI when a dependency's licence cannot be met from this list. Add an identifier only after reading its text and checking it against the rule: nothing linked into the apps stronger than MPL-2.0; the server may use AGPL-compatible licences.

apps.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft, the ceiling for the apps (UniFFI runtime)

androidOnly._about: Not read by check_licences.py (Cargo only): the Android app's Gradle libraries are listed in android/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. Recorded here because one is not open source.

Android-SDK-License.libraries: com.google.android.gms:play-services-cast-framework 23.0.0 and the Google Play services and Google data transport libraries it brings
Android-SDK-License.why: Google Cast for Play on a TV (docs/adr/android-0007-play-on-a-tv.md), approved by the owner on 27 November 2026; closed source, shipped only in the GitHub build, which already needs Google Play services for Android Auto. Their POMs declare the Android Software Development Kit License.

allo-isolate.why: its Cargo.toml declares none; its LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 (read 6 November 2026)
